system.description: Essence Training Package Spell List 14.1.12 - Ocean Law. Spells for navigating, maintaining, and steering a vessel, predicting and controlling weather at sea, and purifying seawater.
Caster learns the dimensions, carrying capacity, average crew size, average running speed, top running speed, and maneuverability of target vessel.
Caster becomes aware of any threatening weather within the area of effect. This spell will only detect weather capable of putting the ship and crew in danger, not simple wind and rain.
Allows caster to know in which direction North lies.

Caster magically marks a location upon the ocean and will know the approximate direction and distance to that location for the duration of the spell. The caster can only have one Location Marker active per 5 levels (round up).
So long as the stars are visible, the caster can determine his exact latitude in the world.
Caster learns the exact depth of the water under him at that moment.
Caster is able to clean all crustacean growth and other buildup from the bottom of his ship. Creatures with a level of 1 or greater get a resistance roll.
Purifies seawater making it suitable for drinking and cooking.
Caster instantly sets target sail to the exact length and tautness that he desires. This allows him to maximize his control and speed on any sailing vessel.
Target(s) of this spell may row at average pace for the exact length of this spell without tiring. Caster may affect up to 1 target per 2 levels.

Caster can move 25 gallons per minute. The water is magically moved up to 50' away in a direction of the caster's choosing. There can be no intervening barriers from the initial location to the target location.
Allows the caster to view objects in the distance as if they were 10 times closer. This gives a +50 to all Observation maneuvers involving objects at a distance.
The caster is able to anticipate which direction the wind will be blowing from in the minutes ahead. Under normal circumstances, this results in a 20% increase in the speed of the vessel.
Totally dissipates all fog within the area of effect for as long as the caster concentrates.
Caster gains knowledge of any areas within area of effect too shallow for the draft of his vessel.

Caster can steer the vessel from anywhere aboard the vessel as though he were at the rudder. This spell must be cast while holding the wheel or rudder. After the spell has been cast, the caster may move freely about the ship.

This spell creates an anchor of force with a connecting chain that will allow a medium sized vessel to hold its position in light winds (waves). It may be cast multiple times to compensate for a larger vessel or heavier waves.
Caster will learn the distance and direction to the nearest dry land (of significant size).

Caster summons a steady strong wind that will blow in any desired direction for one sailing vessel only. This wind should be sufficient to propel any sailing vessel at full speed. If the summoned wind is set against existing wind patterns, then the GM may subtract from the vessel's rate of movement. If this spell is cast directly against a gale force wind or greater, then this spell automatically fails. This spell may only be cast while at sea.

Caster causes the ocean surrounding him to become an area of calmness. This results in 1-2' waves inside the radius of the spell. Heavy waves will get a RR to this spell with a bonus based on their severity (+50 for extremely severe storms). This spell will not cause any change in the amount of rain or wind in the radius.

The caster has a complete knowledge of his vessel for the duration. He will constantly be aware of the direction his ship faces, any damage to the ship, the ship's speed, and the direction of the wind. Further, the confidence gained by the casting of this spell will cause sailors to obey orders from the caster quickly and thoroughly.
Caster knows the exact distance and direction to the last port in which his vessel docked, and becomes aware of the best route to arrive there.
Caster's ship will immediately begin moving at full speed in any desired direction regardless of wind. Caster may change direction at any time during this spell (as often as desired).
